name: Japanese · Phrases · Restaurant and café
source: Phrases: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org) sentences written by native speakers, each linked in its src; lines marked generated were written for Lianki and checked for natural use

entries.reading: なんめいさまですか
entries.note: Staff ask this as you walk in; answer with a number or hold up fingers.

entries.reading: ふたりです
entries.note: Your answer to 何名様ですか; swap in 一人, 三人…

entries.term: 予約してないんですけど、大丈夫ですか？
entries.reading: よやくしてないんですけどだいじょうぶですか
entries.back: We don't have a reservation — is that OK?
entries.note: Walking into a popular place without booking.

entries.term: 恐れ入りますが、本日は満席です。
entries.reading: おそれいりますがほんじつはまんせきです
entries.note: Staff turning you away politely.

entries.term: この席は空いていますか？
entries.reading: このせきはあいていますか
entries.note: Before sitting down in a café or food court.

entries.term: メニューをお願いします。
entries.reading: メニューをおねがいします
entries.note: To staff when no menu is on the table.

entries.term: 英語のメニューはありますか？
entries.reading: えいごのメニューはありますか
entries.back: Do you have an English menu?
entries.note: Many tourist-area places do; ask when you sit down.

entries.term: ご注文はお決まりですか？
entries.reading: ごちゅうもんはおきまりですか
entries.note: Staff line; say もう少し待ってください if you need more time.

entries.term: すみません、注文いいですか？
entries.reading: すみませんちゅうもんいいですか
entries.note: Calling staff over; in Japan you raise a hand and call out すみません.

entries.reading: おすすめはなんですか
entries.note: Ask the server what's good or what the house specialty is.

entries.reading: これください
entries.note: Point at the menu as you say it — perfectly normal.

entries.reading: おなじものをください
entries.note: Ordering what the person before you ordered.

entries.reading: とりあえずビールで
entries.note: The classic first order at an izakaya before looking at food.

entries.reading: なにたのもうかなぁ
entries.note: Thinking aloud with friends while reading the menu.

entries.reading: なにたべたい
entries.back: What do you feel like eating?
entries.note: Deciding where or what to eat with a friend.

entries.term: 魚アレルギーなんです。
entries.reading: さかなアレルギーなんです
entries.note: Tell staff before ordering; swap in 卵, 小麦, えび…

entries.reading: これからいですか
entries.note: Pointing at a dish on the menu.

entries.term: ご注文は以上でよろしいですか？
entries.reading: ごちゅうもんはいじょうでよろしいですか
entries.note: Staff repeat your order and ask this; answer はい.

entries.reading: しょうしょうおまちください
entries.note: Staff saying they'll be right with you or bring it soon.

entries.reading: おみずをください
entries.note: Water is free in Japanese restaurants; often self-service.

entries.term: 店内でお召し上がりですか？
entries.reading: てんないでおめしあがりですか
entries.note: Café and fast-food staff; answer はい or 持ち帰りで.

entries.term: 持ち帰りでお願いします。
entries.reading: もちかえりでおねがいします
entries.note: Your answer at a café or takeout counter.

entries.reading: いただきます
entries.note: Said with hands together right before eating, alone or with others.

entries.reading: かんぱい
entries.note: Glasses up with the first drink; wait for everyone before drinking.

entries.reading: これめっちゃうまい
entries.note: Casual praise among friends; うまい is rougher than おいしい.

entries.reading: もうたべられないよ
entries.note: When you're stuffed and a friend keeps offering food.

entries.reading: おいしかった
entries.note: After a meal, to friends or family.

entries.reading: おかいけいおねがいします
entries.note: To the server or at the register. Polite but everyday.

entries.reading: べつべつでおねがいします
entries.note: Telling the cashier each person will pay for their own.

entries.reading: わりかんにしよう
entries.note: Among friends, suggesting everyone pays an equal share.

entries.reading: ごちそうさまでした
entries.note: After eating, and to staff on the way out; also to whoever treated you.
